_comment: Canonical logical objects the Pharmacy Cost accelerator reasons over. Accelerator-owned and target-agnostic. The customer maps each of their physical tables onto one of these via ACCELERATOR_CORE_ELEMENTS.LOGICAL_OBJECT. Templates gate on presence: a REQUIRED object missing fails the readiness gate; an OPTIONAL object missing causes the dependent arm/join to be dropped.

objects.label: Pharmacy-benefit drug claim line
objects.powers: spine (DENORM_DRUG_SPEND_DETAIL Rx arm), PMPM, trend, generic/specialty/formulary mix
objects.notes: The minimum viable source. Without it there is no drug spend.

objects.label: Member eligibility month
objects.notes: Pharmacy-covered member-months drive every PMPM metric.

objects.label: Analysis period anchor
objects.notes: A single anchor month + horizons. If the customer has none, the accelerator can default to max(service_date).

objects.label: Drug (NDC) reference master
objects.notes: Enriches Rx lines to class-level for most visuals.

objects.label: Medical-benefit (buy-and-bill J-code) drug line
objects.powers: spine medical arm, specialty-medical spend, site-of-care
objects.notes: Absent => medical arm dropped; solution runs Rx-only.

objects.label: Medical claim header
objects.powers: member/status/service dates for medical drug lines
objects.notes: Absent => member/status must be on MEDICAL_DRUG_LINE; header join dropped.

objects.label: Drug rebate source
objects.grain: per NDC (table) OR a column on the claim
objects.powers: net-of-rebate amount, rebate yield by class
objects.notes: May be a table (join) or a rebate-% column on the claim (TRANSFORM/element on RX_DRUG_CLAIM). Absent => net = gross.

objects.label: Formulary drug status
objects.notes: Cardinality drives dedup. Formulary status may also live on the claim.

objects.label: HCPCS (J-code) drug reference
objects.notes: Required only if MEDICAL_DRUG_LINE is present.

objects.label: Drug unit-price history
objects.powers: price component of PVM trend decomposition (MDL_TREND_DRIVERS)
objects.notes: Absent => price/volume/mix collapses to volume+mix only.

objects.label: Prior-authorization request
objects.powers: PA approve/deny/pending mix, UM appropriateness evidence
objects.notes: Absent => PA visual + UM lever omitted.

objects.label: Lab result
objects.notes: Joined temporally (lookback window before drug start).
